coverLetter:
Daniel Okafor
Leeds, UK
daniel.okafor@example.org

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Figma

Dear Hiring Manager,

Raising student attainment by 15 percentage points over three years took more than good explanations. It took tracking progress data, identifying where learners were falling behind, and redesigning the curriculum to close those gaps. That same cycle of diagnosis, tailored enablement, and measurable outcome is exactly what Figma's Senior Customer Enablement Manager role is built around.

Over eight years I have designed training for varied audiences, from 140 students a year across multiple year groups to 12 colleagues learning a new practical curriculum I wrote from scratch. I know how to read a room, adapt content to different maturity levels, and build the kind of trust that makes people actually change how they work. The skills that sit behind that, curriculum design, workshop facilitation, one-to-one coaching, and using data in Google Sheets and Excel to inform decisions, translate directly to building bespoke enablement plans, delivering live and scalable training sessions, and using product data to drive proactive engagement strategies. Figma's "Grow as you go" value also resonates with me: I have self-directed my way through Python and the Google Data Analytics Certificate alongside a full teaching load, which reflects how I approach any new domain.

I am ready to bring that approach to Figma's largest strategic customers and would welcome a conversation about how my background fits the team's needs.

Kind regards,
Daniel Okafor

applicationEmail.body:
Hi Figma team,

Over eight years of designing and delivering training for diverse audiences, including a curriculum I built and rolled out to 12 colleagues, I have developed exactly the consultative, people-first approach your Senior Customer Enablement Manager role calls for. I track progress through data, present findings to senior stakeholders each term, and adapt my approach based on what the numbers show, skills that translate directly into building proactive, evidence-based enablement plans for strategic customers. My CV and cover letter are attached for your review. I am available for a call any weekday from 4 pm GMT onwards and would welcome the chance to discuss how my background fits what you are building at Figma.

Best regards,
Daniel Okafor
